# kmaps

Map Related Functions.  
The package wraps a set of functions related to Leaflet use cases.

## Installation

Install the kmaps package from GitHub as follows:

``` r

pak::pkg_install("thekangaroofactory/kmaps")
```

# Package index

## Geocoding

Functions linked to the Nominatim OpenStreetMap API.

- [`geocode()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/kmaps/reference/geocode.md)
  : Nominatim Geo-coding
- [`rev_geocode()`](https://thekangaroofactory.github.io/kmaps/reference/rev_geocode.md)
  : Nominatim Reverse Geo-coding
